body.message:
Thank you for your message and for considering a stay with us. We truly appreciate you sharing your concerns in advance.

We would like to assure you that the apartment will be thoroughly cleaned before your arrival, with special attention given to the kitchen and all high-use areas. We always strive to maintain a high standard of cleanliness, maintenance, and presentation in line with what is shown in our listing.

Please be assured that we will make sure everything is properly prepared for your stay so you can enjoy a comfortable and pleasant experience during your annual vacation.

We look forward to welcoming you. Thank you.
